arguments.name: name
arguments.text: Element name, taken as written and not evaluated. An exact name wins; otherwise a unique prefix matches.

origin.details: An exact name is used even when a longer name starts with the same characters. Several prefixes and no exact name return a missing result.
origin.value: The named element, or a missing result when the name is absent.

arguments.name: name
arguments.text: Element name as a string. An exact name wins; otherwise a unique prefix matches.

translation.details: An exact name is used even when a longer name starts with the same characters. Several prefixes and no exact name return a missing result.
translation.value: The named element, or a missing result when the name is absent.
